179     def add(
180             self,
181             texts: List[str],
182             metadata: Optional[List[Dict]] = None,
183             table_name: Optional[str] = None,
184             ids: Optional[List[str]] = None,
185     ) -> List[str]:
186         """
187         Adds a list of text items to the specified memory table in the database.
188 
189         Args:
190             texts (List[str]): A list of text strings to be added.
191             metadata (Optional[List[Dict]]): A list of metadata to be added.
192             table_name (Optional[str]): The name of the table to add data to. Defaults to self.table_name.
193             ids (Optional[List[str]]): A list of unique IDs for the text items.
194                 If not provided, random UUIDs are generated.

196         Returns:
197             List[str]: A list of IDs associated with the added text items.
198         """
199         if isinstance(texts, str):
200             texts = (texts,)
201 
202         if metadata is None:
203             metadata = [None, ] * len(texts)
204         elif isinstance(metadata, dict):
205             metadata = (metadata,)
206         else:
207             assert len(texts) == len(metadata)
208 
209         embeds = self.text_embedding.compute_source_embeddings(texts)
210 
211         table_name = table_name or self.table_name
212         ids = ids or [str(uuid.uuid4()) for _ in range(len(texts))]
213 
214         data = [
215             {
216                 "vector": embed,
217                 "text": text,
218                 "id": idx,
219                 "metadata": meta,
220             } for idx, text, embed, meta in zip(ids, texts, embeds, metadata)
221         ]
222 
223         if table_name not in self.client.table_names():
224             self.client.create_table(table_name, data=data)
